audit.rule: P2I-2AB's survivors re-read with their own (pre-P2I-2AC) D and lactate, never refiltered: on each L3 run, P2I-2AB's flag (a sustained substantial fall during a persistent or worsening deficit after haemostasis) and the actual-flow FD-LAC-06. Class per run: PERSISTENT_OR_WORSENING_WITH_RESIDUAL_BLEEDING when a failing pair lies at or after haemostasis in a window with actual flow (an FD-LAC-06 violation); else RECOVERING_WITH_RESIDUAL_BLEEDING when a recovering decline does (allowed); else NO_RESIDUAL_BLEEDING when P2I-2AB's flagged fall lies where the flow had stopped; else ADEQUATE_OR_COMPENSATED. A candidate takes its worse case, in that order. Also counted: the same survivors' violations with the corrected D.

demand.rule: Each candidate is filtered at demand x 0.9, x 1.0 and x 1.1 (the case's metabolic_demand_baseline scaled; demand reaches only the deficit, checked on full core runs). ROBUST: survives at all three; DEMAND-SENSITIVE: at one or two; DEMAND-INCOMPATIBLE: at none. Reported, never a filter: the final region is the one at 1.0, whatever its robustness.

faculty.bleeding: ongoing bleeding is actual flow (current blood loss rate > 0), not the haemostasis event label; after 60 a residual bleed with a PERSISTENT or WORSENING critical deficit keeps FD-LAC-06's protection; RECOVERING_CRITICAL or deficit == 0 still allows a decline; fraction_after_hemostasis unchanged (FD-25 pending)
faculty.debt: D is accumulated oxygen-delivery debt: while effective_oxygen_deficit > 0 it does not decrease (production continues, repayment suspended, dD >= 0); with deficit == 0 it may repay gradually with tau_D. No channel added; the deficit, DO2, extraction, tau_D, the D gain and the lactate gain unchanged
faculty.demand: metabolic demand 0.9 / 1.0 / 1.1 as explicit uncertainty: ROBUST (all three), DEMAND-SENSITIVE (some), DEMAND-INCOMPATIBLE (none); no value approved, case truth unchanged, robustness never a filter
faculty.fd_lac_04: unchanged: L(T*+30) < L(T*), no fixed 10 %; 5 / 10 / 15 % diagnostic only
faculty.fd_lac_05: unchanged: 57m 1.5-4.0, 72f 1.2-3.5, L120 < L(T*); remaining NOT_EVALUABLE reported with its reason
faculty.l3_adequacy: L3_RESUSCITATION_ADEQUACY: after 2 red-cell units and haemostasis at 60, sustained effective_deficit == 0 (ADEQUATE or COMPENSATED) begins no later than minute 90 (>= 30 min observed by 120); otherwise L3_RESUSCITATION_INADEQUATE, rejected from the final region and reported apart, never an FD-LAC-04 failure
faculty.rho: physiological band 2.0-3.0, 2.5 representative; 1 only as SYNTHETIC_REFERENCE; rho not counted in the candidate multiplicity; reported as non-identifiable (invariant)

debt_per_delivery_deficit.structural: only G x g (and G x arrival debt) reaches lactate

lactate_per_output_deficit.structural: only G x g (and G x arrival debt) reaches lactate

rho.status: NON_IDENTIFIABLE (invariant): rho cancels in deficit, D, lactate and adequacy because the arrival ratio is re-anchored as ratio / rho; evaluated at 2.5 (representative of the 2.0-3.0 band), checked at 2.0 and 3.0, 1 only as SYNTHETIC_REFERENCE; never counted in the candidate multiplicity

identifiability.rule: On the final region (demand 1.0), per dimension, against the values present in the source space, as P2I-2AB: one value explored = NOT_VARIED; one left = WELL_CONSTRAINED; some excluded = PARTIALLY_CONSTRAINED; none excluded = POORLY_IDENTIFIED; structural = NON_IDENTIFIABLE_SEPARATELY (G and g reach lactate only as G x g with G x arrival debt). rho is not a dimension of the candidates (RHO_STATUS). Demand is read on the union of the three filters (the factors at which a candidate survives). Each status is set beside P2I-2AB's: NARROWER when fewer values survive, SAME, WIDER when more. No value is chosen by frequency.

legacy_reference.rule: LEGACY REFERENCE, NOT A CALIBRATION TARGET: the family engine's own lactate at 0, 15, 30, 60, 90 and 120 min, read after the filter and the representatives, never by a constraint or an ordering.

policy: Shadow only. The P2I-2AB current source space (its committed record), never the P2F historical region (P2FGuard). D is the core's corrected accumulated debt; FD-LAC-02..05 are faculty_constraints' frozen functions; FD-LAC-01 and 06 read the 2026-10-28 recovery semantics with windows from the actual flow; L3 adequacy is its own rejection. Demand 0.9 / 1.1 is reported uncertainty, 1.0 the region; rho is not counted. Haemodynamics are simulated once and D and lactate post-processed exactly (validated, else stop). The legacy lactate is read after the filter only. Nothing is fitted, selected or approved; no SBP, MAP or HR is calibrated; collapse stays off.

region.status: FACULTY-CONSTRAINED CURRENT-PHYSIOLOGY LACTATE REGION (no value selected or approved)

fd04_sensitivity.note: diagnostic only: survivors that would also pass FD-LAC-04 with the fall required at the threshold; never filters

recovering_declines_allowed.note: survivors whose run had a sustained substantial decline the semantics allowed as RECOVERING_CRITICAL

validation.rule: P2I-2AB's sample (per rate the first, middle and last P3 set; lactate-side indices 0, n/4, n/2, 3n/4, n-1 and the canonical point; L1, L3 and L2 at the first and last crystalloid point; both cases) at reserve 2.5, demand 1.0 and intrinsic midpoint: exact equality of every minute's lactate, D, deficit and actual flow, of haemostasis and stop, and of every verdict (FD-LAC, L3 adequacy, active and residual FD-LAC-06). On the canonical point also demand 0.9 and 1.1 and intrinsic lower / upper (exact), and reserve 2.0, 3.0 and the synthetic reference 1 (within 1e-9, identical verdicts). Any disagreement stops the run.

blockers: FD-LAC-04 / 05 are met only as NOT_EVALUABLE by some survivors
verdict.rule: LACTATE_PHYSIOLOGY_READY_FOR_NEXT_DOMAIN when every check holds: the P2I-2AB record is the committed one; the factorization agrees with the full core (D never falls under a deficit the core read); D is coherent in every representative run (never falls under a core-read deficit; any end-state exception is an onset minute); at least one candidate survives at demand 1.0; every survivor restores L3 adequacy in both cases; FD-LAC-04 is PASS or ALREADY_NORMALIZED and FD-LAC-05 PASS in both cases for every survivor (no definitive-management constraint met only as NOT_EVALUABLE); residual bleeding is read by actual flow (the L3 runs carry the flow after haemostasis and the validation reproduces it exactly); the demand layer classified every candidate; and no representative carries a patient-like flag (WORSENING_CRITICAL_WITH_LARGE_LACTATE_FALL, INSTANT_NORMALIZATION, INCOMPATIBLE_WITH_SURVIVAL). Otherwise LACTATE_PHYSIOLOGY_NOT_READY with the first blocker. No candidate, value or parameter is selected or approved.
verdict.verdict: LACTATE_PHYSIOLOGY_NOT_READY — FD-LAC-04 / 05 are met only as NOT_EVALUABLE by some survivors
